title: Composing What Each Teacher Learned: Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation through Teacher-Relative Shifts
abstract: arXiv:2610.10460v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) is used in two settings. In common-domain composition, several teachers score each student rollout from one prompt domain and their signals form a single target; in routed-domain distillation, prompts from different domains are assigned to the corresponding specialist. Both settings usually transfer each teacher's endpoint policy, which mixes what post-training changed with preferences inherited from the teacher's base. We introduce $\Delta$-MOPD, which transfers each teacher's teacher-minus-base logit shift re-anchored at the student's frozen initialization, and compare it with endpoint supervision in both settings while holding teacher selection fixed. We first expose the mechanism that impedes endpoint transfer: inherited base pull can exceed the post-training shift. Removing it reduces the teacher-term norm ratio and target--student KL. translated_title: 组合每位教师所学到的知识：通过教师相对偏移实现的多教师在线策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 多教师在线策略蒸馏（MOPD）被应用于两种设置。在共同域组合中，多个教师对来自同一提示域的学生每个 rollout 进行评分，其信号共同构成一个单一目标；在路由域蒸馏中，来自不同域的提示被分配给相应的专家教师。这两种设置通常迁移的是每个教师的端点策略，而端点策略将后训练所改变的偏好与教师从其基础模型继承而来的偏好混杂在一起。我们提出 Δ-MOPD，它迁移的是每个教师的“教师减去基础”的 logit 偏移，并将其重新锚定在学生的冻结初始状态上，同时在保持教师选择固定的情况下，将其与端点监督在两种设置中进行比较。我们首先揭示了阻碍端点迁移的机制：继承的基础拉力可能超过后训练偏移。移除它可以降低教师项范数比以及目标与学生之间的 KL 散度。在我们的所有实验中，结果表明偏移（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出 Δ-MOPD，通过迁移教师相对其基础模型的 logit 偏移并重新锚定到学生的冻结初始状态，消除端点策略中继承的基础模型偏好干扰，从而在多教师在线策略蒸馏的两种设置中降低教师项范数比和目标-学生 KL，实现更纯粹的教师后训练知识传递。
en_tdlr: Δ-MOPD transfers each teacher's teacher-minus-base logit shift re-anchored at the student's frozen initialization instead of endpoint policies, removing inherited base preference interference to reduce the teacher-term norm ratio and target–student KL in multi-teacher on-policy distillation.
